resources.string: Enter a six-byte hexadecimal MAC address. Android’s hidden address 02:00:00:00:00:00 cannot be used.
Colon, hyphen, dotted and 12-digit MAC formats are accepted. A BSSID does not encode a country.
Invalid device MAC address. Leave blank if it is not needed.
Use four decimal octets from 0 to 255, or leave blank.
